I. 'संवाद कौमुदी' का प्रकाशन
II. साप्ताहिक पत्रिका 'बंगाल गज़ट' का प्रकाशन

questions.text_english:
Arrange the following events of 'print culture' in chronological order and choose the correct option :
I. Publication of 'Sambad Kaumudi'
II. Publication of weekly magazine 'Bengal Gazette'
III. 'Vernacular Press Act' was implemented
IV. The first printed edition of the 'Ramcharitmanas'
questions.solution: The correct chronological order is D: II, IV, I, III. The Bengal Gazette was published first in 1780 by James Augustus Hickey. The first printed edition of Ramcharitmanas appeared in the 19th century. Sambad Kaumudi was published by Ram Mohan Roy in 1821. The Vernacular Press Act was enacted in 1878 to suppress Indian-language newspapers. Options A and B incorrectly place the Vernacular Press Act at the start, while C incorrectly sequences the Sambad Kaumudi before the Bengal Gazette.
questions.solution_hindi: सही कालानुक्रम D: II, IV, I, III है। बंगाल गज़ट 1780 में जेम्स ऑगस्टस हिकी द्वारा प्रकाशित हुई। रामचरितमानस का पहला मुद्रित संस्करण 19वीं सदी में आया। संवाद कौमुदी 1821 में राम मोहन राय ने प्रकाशित की। वर्नाक्युलर प्रेस एक्ट 1878 में लागू हुआ।

questions.solution: The correct answer is B: Diamond Sutra. The image shows a page from the Diamond Sutra, which is the world's oldest printed book with a known date, printed in China in 868 CE using woodblock printing. It is a Buddhist scripture written in Chinese characters. Korean Jikji is the oldest surviving book printed with movable metal type. Tripitaka Koreana is a collection of Buddhist scriptures on wooden blocks from Korea. Chinese script alone is simply a writing system, not a specific book.

questions.text_english:
Choose the correct option to fill in the blank.
The Indus Valley Civilization was linked to the _______ region through coastal trade as early as 3000 BCE.
questions.solution: The correct answer is C: West Asia. Archaeological evidence and artifacts discovered at Indus Valley sites such as Mohenjo-daro and Harappa confirm that the Indus Valley Civilization had active coastal and maritime trade with West Asian regions, including Mesopotamia (present-day Iraq), as early as 3000 BCE. North America, South America, and South Australia had no trade contact with the Indus Valley in this period.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर C: पश्चिम एशिया है। पुरातात्विक साक्ष्यों से पता चलता है कि सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता 3000 ईसा पूर्व से पश्चिम एशिया, विशेषकर मेसोपोटामिया के साथ समुद्री व्यापार करती थी।

नीचे दो कथनों को अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) के रूप में अंकित किया गया है। दोनों कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
अभिकथन (A) : सोलहवीं सदी के मध्य तक आते-आते पुर्तगाली और स्पेनिश सेनाओं की विजय का सिलसिला शुरू हो चुका था तथा उन्होंने अमेरिका को उपनिवेश बनाना शुरू कर दिया था।
कारण (R) : स्पेनिश विजेताओं के पास सबसे शक्तिशाली परंपरागत हथियार थे।
questions.text_english:
Two statements labelled as Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are given below. Read both the statements carefully and choose the correct option :
Assertion (A) : The Portuguese and Spanish conquest and colonisation of America was decisively under way by the mid-sixteenth century.
Reason (R) : The Spanish conquerors had the most powerful conventional weapons.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं और कारण (R) अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, परंतु कारण (R) अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परंतु कारण (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परंतु कारण (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: The correct answer is C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false. Assertion A is historically accurate — by the mid-sixteenth century, Spanish and Portuguese conquest of America was well under way. However, Reason R is false because the Spanish conquerors did not win primarily through conventional weapons. The key factor was the spread of germs such as smallpox, to which native American populations had no immunity, wiping out entire communities. This biological factor, not conventional weaponry superiority, was the decisive cause.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर C है। अभिकथन सत्य है क्योंकि 16वीं सदी के मध्य तक स्पेन और पुर्तगाल ने अमेरिका पर विजय प्राप्त कर ली थी। लेकिन कारण असत्य है क्योंकि विजय का मुख्य कारण पारंपरिक हथियार नहीं बल्कि चेचक जैसी बीमारियाँ थीं जिनसे मूल निवासियों की बड़े पैमाने पर मृत्यु हुई।

questions.text_english:
(a) Analyse Gutenberg's contribution to printing in Europe.
OR
(b) "Printing is the ultimate gift of God and the greatest one." Analyse the statement.
questions.instruction_line: किसी एक प्रश्न का उत्तर लिखिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Answer any one of the following.

key_points: Gutenberg developed the printing press with movable type around 1448 in Europe
He adapted the screw press used in wine and olive oil production
He printed the Bible — 180 copies in three years, which was a revolutionary speed
His press spread rapidly across Europe enabling mass production of books

questions.solution:
Johannes Gutenberg developed Europe's first printing press with movable type around 1448 in Strasbourg, Germany. He adapted the technology of the screw press, used in wine and olive oil production, to create a machine that could press inked type onto paper rapidly. Gutenberg's most celebrated achievement was the printing of the Bible, producing around 180 copies in approximately three years — a speed unimaginable with handwritten manuscripts. Before his invention, books were laboriously copied by hand and available only to the wealthy and the clergy. Gutenberg's press made books affordable and widely available, spreading new ideas, literacy, and knowledge across Europe. This printing revolution eventually contributed to the Protestant Reformation, the Scientific Revolution, and the rise of nationalism. His contribution transformed European society by making the written word accessible to common people for the first time.

For part (b): Martin Luther called print 'the ultimate gift of God and the greatest one.' This statement reflects how printing transformed religious and intellectual life. Before print, the Catholic Church controlled the spread of religious texts. The printing press enabled Luther to publish his 95 Theses in 1517, and within fifteen days they spread across Germany. Print allowed the Bible to be translated into vernacular languages, enabling ordinary people to read and interpret scripture themselves. Printed pamphlets and books spread new ideas of science, philosophy, and democracy rapidly. Print thus became a powerful agent of social change, challenging authority and empowering common people — truly a divine gift that reshaped civilisation.
questions.solution_hindi: जोहानिस गुटेन्बर्ग ने लगभग 1448 में जर्मनी के स्ट्रासबर्ग में यूरोप की पहली छापाखाना मशीन (मूवेबल टाइप प्रेस) विकसित की। उन्होंने अंगूर और जैतून तेल निकालने के स्क्रू प्रेस को अनुकूलित करके यह मशीन बनाई। गुटेन्बर्ग की सबसे बड़ी उपलब्धि बाइबिल की लगभग 180 प्रतियाँ तीन वर्षों में छापना था। उनके आविष्कार से पुस्तकें सस्ती और सुलभ हुईं तथा यूरोप में ज्ञान का प्रसार हुआ।

questions.text:
(क) 1789 में फ्रांसीसी क्रांति को राष्ट्रवाद की पहली स्पष्ट अभिव्यक्ति क्यों माना जाता है ? उदाहरणों सहित स्पष्ट कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) साम्राज्यवाद से जुड़कर राष्ट्रवाद किस प्रकार 1914 में यूरोप को महाविपदा की ओर ले गया ? उदाहरणों सहित स्पष्ट कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Why is the French Revolution of 1789 considered the first clear expression of nationalism? Explain with examples.
OR
(b) How did nationalism, aligned with imperialism, lead Europe to disaster in 1914? Explain with examples.
questions.instruction_line: किसी एक प्रश्न का उत्तर लिखिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Answer any one of the following.

key_points: The French Revolution transferred sovereignty from the monarchy to the French nation
Ideas of liberty, equality and fraternity were proclaimed
A new French army was created based on the idea of a nation in arms
French language was promoted as the language of the nation
Estates General was converted into National Assembly representing the people
Nationalist ideas spread across Europe through Napoleon's conquests

questions.solution:
The French Revolution of 1789 is considered the first clear expression of nationalism because it fundamentally changed the basis of political power and identity. Before 1789, France was a monarchy where sovereignty resided in the king. The Revolution transferred sovereignty to the French nation — the people collectively became the source of all political authority. The Estates General was transformed into a National Assembly, signifying that the nation, not the king, was supreme. Ideas of liberty, equality, and fraternity were proclaimed as universal rights, giving citizens a shared identity. The revolutionaries promoted the French language, creating a uniform national culture. A new citizen army — the 'nation in arms' — was created, where soldiers fought not for a king but for the nation. National symbols such as the tricolour flag, the national anthem La Marseillaise, and the Declaration of the Rights of Man gave the French a common identity. These revolutionary ideas spread across Europe through Napoleon's armies, inspiring nationalist movements in other countries. Thus, the French Revolution first demonstrated that a modern state could be built around the concept of a united nation of free and equal citizens.

For part (b): By the early twentieth century, nationalism in Europe had become closely linked with imperial ambitions. European nations competed fiercely for colonies in Africa and Asia, and this rivalry created tensions among the major powers. The Balkans became the most dangerous flashpoint. As the Ottoman Empire declined, various Balkan nations — Serbia, Bulgaria, Romania — sought to gain territory and assert their national identity, supported by Russia, while Austria-Hungary tried to suppress Slav nationalism. Intense competition among European powers led to the formation of rival military alliances — the Triple Alliance (Germany, Austria-Hungary, Italy) and the Triple Entente (France, Russia, Britain). When Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria-Hungary was assassinated in Sarajevo by a Bosnian Serb nationalist in June 1914, the alliance system pulled all major European powers into war. Nationalist pride, imperial rivalry, and militarism combined to turn a regional dispute into the catastrophe of World War I, killing millions and destroying the old European order.
questions.solution_hindi: 1789 की फ्रांसीसी क्रांति राष्ट्रवाद की पहली स्पष्ट अभिव्यक्ति मानी जाती है क्योंकि इसने राजनीतिक सत्ता का आधार राजतंत्र से जनता को हस्तांतरित किया। राष्ट्रीय सभा, स्वतंत्रता-समानता-बंधुत्व के विचार, नागरिक सेना और राष्ट्रीय प्रतीकों ने फ्रांस को एकजुट राष्ट्र की पहचान दी। ये विचार नेपोलियन की सेनाओं के माध्यम से पूरे यूरोप में फैले।

questions.text:
दिए गए स्रोत को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और उसके नीचे दिए गए प्रश्नों के उत्तर लिखिए :

भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन

क्रिप्स मिशन की असफलता एवं द्वितीय विश्व युद्ध के प्रभावों ने भारत में व्यापक असंतोष को जन्म दिया। इसके फलस्वरूप गाँधीजी ने एक आंदोलन शुरू किया, जिसमें उन्होंने अंग्रेज़ों के पूरी तरह से भारत छोड़ने पर ज़ोर दिया। वर्धा में 14 जुलाई 1942 को अपनी कार्यकारिणी में काँग्रेस कार्य समिति ने ऐतिहासिक 'भारत छोड़ो' प्रस्ताव पारित किया, जिसमें सत्ता का भारतीयों को तत्काल हस्तांतरण एवं भारत छोड़ने की माँग की गई। 8 अगस्त 1942 को बंबई में अखिल भारतीय काँग्रेस समिति ने इस प्रस्ताव का समर्थन किया, जिसमें पूरे देश में व्यापक पैमाने पर एक अहिंसक जन संघर्ष का आह्वान किया गया। इसी अवसर पर गाँधीजी ने प्रसिद्ध 'करो या मरो' भाषण दिया था। 'भारत छोड़ो' के इस आह्वान ने देश के अधिकतर हिस्सों में राज्य व्यवस्था को ठप्प कर दिया, लोग स्वत: ही आन्दोलन में कूद पड़े। लोगों ने हड़तालें कीं और राष्ट्रीय गीतों एवं नारों के साथ प्रदर्शन किए एवं जुलूस निकाले। यह आंदोलन वास्तव में एक जन आन्दोलन था जिसमें छात्र, मज़दूर और किसान जैसे हज़ारों साधारण लोगों ने हिस्सा लिया। इसमें नेताओं की सक्रिय भागीदारी भी देखी गई जिनमें जयप्रकाश नारायण, अरूणा आसफ अली एवं राम मनोहर लोहिया और बहुत सारी महिलाएँ जैसे बंगाल से मातांगिनी हाजरा, असम से कनकलता बरूआ और उड़ीसा से रमा देवी थीं। अंग्रेज़ों द्वारा अत्यधिक बल प्रयोग के बावजूद इसे दबाने में एक वर्ष से अधिक समय लग गया।
questions.text_english:
Read the given source carefully and answer the questions that follow :

Quit India Movement

The failure of the Cripps Mission and the effects of World War II created widespread discontentment in India. This led Gandhiji to launch a movement calling for complete withdrawal of the British from India. The Congress Working Committee, in its meeting in Wardha on 14 July, 1942, passed the historic 'Quit India' resolution demanding the immediate transfer of power to Indians and quit India. On 8 August 1942 in Bombay, the All India Congress Committee endorsed the resolution, which called for a non-violent mass struggle on the widest possible scale throughout the country. It was on this occasion that Gandhiji delivered the famous 'Do or Die' speech. The call for 'Quit India' almost brought the state machinery to a standstill in large parts of the country as people voluntarily threw themselves into the thick of the movement. People observed hartals and demonstrations and processions were accompanied by national songs and slogans. The movement was truly a mass movement which brought into its ambit thousands of ordinary people, namely students, workers and peasants. Small landholdings are cultivated intensively using human labour and simple tools
Farmers use high inputs of labour and fertilisers to get maximum yield from small plots
Multiple cropping is practised to feed large populations from limited land

questions.solution: Intensive subsistence farming is practised in regions with high population density, particularly in monsoon Asia including India, China, and Bangladesh. Because the land available per family is very small, farmers cultivate it with maximum intensity to produce enough food for survival. They use large amounts of human labour, simple tools, and traditional methods to extract the highest possible output from small plots. High yielding variety seeds, fertilisers, and irrigation are applied wherever possible. Multiple cropping — growing two or three crops on the same land in a year — is commonly practised to meet the food needs of large families. Thus, population pressure directly forces farmers to use land more intensively.

questions.instruction_line: किसी एक प्रश्न का उत्तर लिखिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Answer any one of the following.

key_points: Manufacturing converts raw materials into finished goods, adding value
Industries provide large-scale employment reducing poverty
Manufacturing promotes exports earning foreign exchange
Industrial growth stimulates other sectors including services and agriculture
Developed nations have strong manufacturing bases
India's industrial growth since independence has reduced dependence on imports

questions.solution:
Manufacturing industries are the backbone of economic development. They convert raw materials into finished goods, adding significant value and generating national income. A strong manufacturing sector creates millions of jobs, reducing unemployment and poverty, as seen in countries like Japan, Germany, and China which became economic superpowers through industrialisation. Manufacturing promotes export earnings, bringing in foreign exchange that strengthens the economy. It also stimulates growth in other sectors — agriculture benefits from industrial inputs like fertilisers and machinery, while services like transport and banking expand alongside industry. In India, development of industries like steel, textiles, automobiles, and electronics since independence has reduced import dependence and increased self-reliance. Industrial growth leads to urbanisation and infrastructure development, raising the overall standard of living. Therefore, the level of industrial development is a reliable measure of a country's economic strength.

For part (b): Industrial pollution poses a serious threat to India's water resources. Industries discharge untreated effluents containing heavy metals, toxic chemicals, and acids into rivers, lakes, and groundwater. Rivers like the Ganga and Yamuna have become severely polluted due to industrial waste from textile, leather tanning, and chemical factories. This contaminated water is unfit for drinking, agriculture, and aquatic life, causing serious public health problems including waterborne diseases. India has limited freshwater resources — only 4% of the world's freshwater despite 16% of the world's population. Groundwater depletion and pollution reduce availability further. Saving clean water requires treating industrial effluents before discharge, implementing strict pollution control laws, promoting water recycling in industries, and using eco-friendly industrial processes. Protecting water is essential for public health, food security, and sustainable development.

भारत में संयुक्त वन प्रबंधन कार्यक्रम क्षरित वनों के प्रबंध और पुनर्निमाण में स्थानीय समुदायों की भूमिका के महत्त्व को उजागर करते हैं। औपचारिक रूप से इन कार्यक्रमों की शुरुआत 1988 में हुई जब ओडिशा राज्य ने संयुक्त वन प्रबंधन का पहला प्रस्ताव पास किया। वन विभाग के अंतर्गत 'संयुक्त वन प्रबंधन' क्षरित वनों के बचाव के लिए कार्य करता है और इसमें गाँव के स्तर पर संस्थाएँ बनाई जाती हैं जिसमें ग्रामीण और वन विभाग के अधिकारी संयुक्त रूप में कार्य करते हैं। इसके बदले ये समुदाय मध्य स्तरीय लाभ जैसे गैर-इमारती वन उत्पादों के हकदारी होते हैं तथा सफल संरक्षण से प्राप्त इमारती लकड़ी लाभ में भी भागीदार होते हैं।

questions.text_english:

Joint Forest Management

In India the Joint Forest Management (JFM) programme furnishes a good example for involving local communities in the management and restoration of degraded forests. The programme has been in formal existence since 1988 when the state of Odisha passed the first resolution for joint forest management. JFM depends on the formation of local (village) institutions that undertake protection activities mostly on degraded forest land managed by the forest department. In return, the members of these communities are entitled to intermediary benefits like non-timber forest produces and share in the timber harvested by 'successful protection'.

The clear lesson from the dynamics of both environmental destruction and reconstruction in India is that local communities everywhere have to be involved in some kind of natural resource management. But there is still a long way to go before local communities are at the centre-stage in decision-making. Accept only those economic or developmental activities, that are people centric, environment-friendly and economically rewarding.

questions.text_english: Which one of the following is the best example of 'coming together federation' ?
questions.solution: The correct answer is D: Switzerland. 'Coming together federation' refers to independent states that voluntarily come together and merge to form a bigger unit, pooling their sovereignty for mutual benefit. Switzerland, the USA, and Australia are classic examples of coming together federations, formed when independent states voluntarily united. India and Spain are examples of 'holding together federations', where a large country decides to divide power between the central government and states. England is a unitary state, not a federal one.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर D: स्विट्जरलैंड है। 'साथ आकर संघ बनाना' वह प्रक्रिया है जिसमें स्वतंत्र राज्य स्वेच्छा से मिलकर एक बड़ी इकाई बनाते हैं। स्विट्जरलैंड, अमेरिका और ऑस्ट्रेलिया इसके उदाहरण हैं। भारत 'साथ मिलकर' फेडरेशन का उदाहरण है।

questions.text_english: Which one of the following countries has a high level of women's participation in public life ?
questions.solution: The correct answer is A: Sweden. Sweden is consistently ranked among the top countries in the world for gender equality and women's participation in public, political, and professional life. The Nordic countries including Sweden, Norway, and Finland have achieved near-equal representation of women in their parliaments and cabinets. India has relatively low women's representation in Parliament and state legislatures. Canada and Brazil have moderate levels of women's participation, but they do not match Sweden's record.

questions.solution: Political parties play an essential role in a democracy. They contest elections by putting up candidates and seeking votes. Parties formulate policies and programmes that represent the interests of different sections of society. The party that wins forms the government, while others form the opposition that checks and balances the ruling party. Parties educate citizens about political issues and mobilise public opinion. They also recruit and train political leaders.

Political parties should voluntarily give more election tickets to women candidates. Women's education and economic empowerment must be strengthened so they can confidently participate in politics. Awareness campaigns to break social barriers and encourage women's political participation are also essential.

questions.text_english: How is democracy better than other forms of government in promoting freedom of citizens? Explain with examples.

key_points: Democracy guarantees fundamental rights such as freedom of speech, expression, and movement
Citizens can hold the government accountable through elections
Independent judiciary protects citizens from arbitrary state action
Dictatorships suppress freedom — example of China or North Korea

questions.solution: Democracy is superior to other forms of government in promoting freedom because it guarantees fundamental rights to all citizens. In India, rights like freedom of speech, expression, movement, and religion are constitutionally protected. Citizens can criticise the government, form associations, and vote out rulers they dislike — checks that do not exist in dictatorships. In authoritarian regimes like North Korea or the former Soviet Union, citizens had no right to dissent. Democracy has an independent judiciary that protects individuals from arbitrary state action. Free press and civil society further hold power accountable. Thus democracy creates a system where freedom is not just promised but institutionally protected.

(a) Describe the main functions of political parties.
OR
(b) Describe the main challenges before political parties in India.
questions.instruction_line: किसी एक प्रश्न का उत्तर लिखिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Answer any one of the following.

key_points: Parties contest elections and seek to win political power
They put forward policies and programmes for voters to choose
They play a decisive role in making laws in the legislature
Parties that lose elections form the opposition and criticise the government
Parties shape public opinion through debates, rallies, and media
Parties provide people access to government machinery and welfare schemes

questions.solution:
Political parties perform several vital functions in a democracy. First, they contest elections — parties select candidates, campaign on their behalf, and mobilise voters. Second, they formulate policies and programmes that reflect the interests of different sections of society; voters choose the party whose policies they support. Third, parties play a crucial role in lawmaking — members of the ruling party vote in the legislature to pass laws, while the opposition debates and critiques proposed legislation. Fourth, opposition parties keep the ruling party in check by exposing failures and presenting alternative policies. Fifth, parties shape public opinion by raising issues through rallies, pamphlets, and media. Sixth, parties provide ordinary citizens access to government machinery by acting as intermediaries between people and the state.

For part (b): Political parties in India face several serious challenges. The first is internal democracy — parties are often controlled by one family or leader, with little internal election or consultation. The second is dynastic succession, where leadership passes within families, discouraging talented ordinary workers from rising. The third is the role of money — elections have become very expensive, forcing parties to depend on wealthy donors and leading to corruption. The fourth is the growing role of criminals — many candidates with criminal records are given tickets because they can win elections by using muscle power. The fifth is the challenge of ideology — parties shift positions for electoral convenience, making it hard for voters to distinguish between them. These challenges undermine the quality of democratic competition.

questions.text_english:
Read the given source carefully and answer the questions that follow :

Forms of power sharing

The idea of power sharing has emerged in opposition to the notions of undivided political power. For a long time, it was believed that all power of a government must reside in one person or group of persons located at one place. It was felt that if the power to decide is dispersed, it would not be possible to take quick decisions and to enforce them. But these notions have changed with the emergence of democracy. One basic principle of democracy is that people are the source of all political power. In a democracy, people rule themselves through institutions of self-government. In a good democratic government, due respect is given to diverse groups and views that exist in a society. Everyone has a voice in the shaping of public policies. Therefore, it follows that in a democracy, political power should be distributed among as many citizens as possible.

sub_questions.text_english: Why should all the powers of the government not be in the hands of one person ?

key_points: Concentrating all power in one person leads to tyranny and ignores the interests of diverse groups in society. It undermines democracy, where people are the source of all political power.

sub_questions.solution: Concentrating all governmental power in one person's hands leads to autocracy and tyranny. It means that diverse groups, opinions, and interests in society are ignored. In a democracy, the basic principle is that people are the source of all political power. When power is concentrated, accountability is lost and policies can be made for the benefit of a few rather than the many.

sub_questions.text: सत्ता का बँटवारा क्यों आवश्यक है ?

key_points: Power sharing is necessary to prevent concentration of power, accommodate diverse social groups, ensure stability, and make democracy meaningful by giving all citizens a voice in governance.

sub_questions.solution: Power sharing is necessary because it prevents the abuse of power by any one person or group. It ensures that diverse communities and social groups are represented in governance and their interests are protected. It promotes political stability by reducing conflicts that arise when some groups feel excluded. Most importantly, power sharing makes democracy genuine by ensuring that all citizens have a meaningful role in shaping public policies.

key_points: Self-government institutions like Panchayati Raj bring government closer to the people

sub_questions.solution: Governing through institutions of self-government strengthens democracy by bringing decision-making closer to the people. Institutions like Panchayati Raj in India allow ordinary citizens at the village level to directly participate in governance and make decisions about local issues such as roads, schools, and water supply. This ensures that public policies truly reflect the needs of local communities rather than being imposed from above. It also builds political awareness and accountability at the grassroots level, making democracy more meaningful and participatory for the largest number of citizens.

questions.text_english:
If companies decide to import cotton from other countries, what will be its impact on domestic cotton cultivation ? Choose the most appropriate option :
I. Less profitable
II. More profitable
III. The price of domestic cotton will decrease
IV. The price of domestic cotton will increase

options.A: केवल I और IV सही हैं।
options.B: केवल I और III सही हैं।
options.C: केवल II और III सही हैं।
options.D: केवल II और IV सही हैं।

options_english.A: Only I and IV are correct.
options_english.B: Only I and III are correct.
options_english.C: Only II and III are correct.
options_english.D: Only II and IV are correct.

questions.solution: The correct answer is B: Only I and III are correct. When companies import cheaper cotton from other countries, domestic cotton farmers face competition from the cheaper imported cotton. This makes domestic cotton farming less profitable (I is correct) because companies prefer to buy cheaper imported cotton. As demand for domestic cotton falls, its price decreases (III is correct). Statements II and IV are incorrect — domestic farming becomes less, not more, profitable, and prices fall, not rise.

नीचे दो कथन I एवं II दिए गए हैं। दोनों कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
कथन I : 'माँग जमा' को माँग पर निकाला जा सकता है।
कथन II : 'माँग जमा' नकदी के उपयोग के बिना सीधे भुगतान का निपटान करती है।
questions.text_english:
Two statements I and II are given below. Read both the statements carefully and choose the correct option :
Statement I : 'Demand deposits' can be withdrawn on demand.
Statement II : 'Demand deposits' settle payments directly without the use of cash.

options.A: कथन I सही है, परन्तु कथन II गलत है।
options.B: कथन I गलत है, परन्तु कथन II सही है।
options.C: कथन I और कथन II दोनों सही हैं।
options.D: कथन I और कथन II दोनों गलत हैं।

options_english.A: Statement I is correct, but Statement II is incorrect.
options_english.B: Statement I is incorrect, but Statement II is correct.
options_english.C: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.
options_english.D: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect.

questions.solution: The correct answer is C: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct. Demand deposits, held in savings and current accounts in banks, can be withdrawn by the depositor at any time on demand — this is what distinguishes them from fixed deposits (Statement I is correct). Demand deposits also facilitate cashless transactions through cheques, online transfers, and debit cards, allowing payments to be settled directly without physical cash (Statement II is correct). Both statements accurately describe the characteristics of demand deposits.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर C: दोनों कथन सही हैं। माँग जमा (Demand Deposits) को किसी भी समय निकाला जा सकता है। ये चेक, ऑनलाइन ट्रांसफर आदि के माध्यम से नकदी के बिना भुगतान का निपटान भी करती हैं।

questions.text: एक समृद्ध किसान के लिए विकासात्मक लक्ष्य हो सकता है :
questions.text_english: The developmental goal for a prosperous farmer can be :
questions.solution: The correct answer is A: Higher support price for crops. A prosperous farmer's primary developmental goal would be to receive a higher Minimum Support Price (MSP) for the crops he grows, as this directly increases his income and profits. Options B and D — more days of work and better wages — are goals of agricultural labourers or workers who earn daily wages, not of a prosperous farmer who owns land. Option C — prohibition of social discrimination — is a goal more relevant to marginalised communities rather than a prosperous farmer's economic aspiration.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर A: फसल का अधिक समर्थन मूल्य है। एक समृद्ध किसान का मुख्य विकासात्मक लक्ष्य अपनी फसल का अधिक न्यूनतम समर्थन मूल्य (MSP) पाना होगा, जिससे उसकी आय बढ़े। काम के दिन और मजदूरी कृषि मज़दूरों के लक्ष्य हैं।

questions.text: अर्थव्यवस्था के निजी क्षेत्रक की सही विशेषता का चयन कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Choose the correct characteristic of private sector of the economy.
questions.solution: The correct answer is B: Individually controlled. The private sector of the economy is owned and controlled by private individuals or groups of individuals, with the primary aim of earning profit. Option A (government controlled) describes the public sector. Options C and D (working for public welfare and the poor) describe the objectives of the public sector or NGOs, not the private sector, which is profit-driven.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर B: व्यक्तिगत तौर पर नियंत्रित है। निजी क्षेत्रक का स्वामित्व और नियंत्रण निजी व्यक्तियों के हाथ में होता है और इसका मुख्य उद्देश्य लाभ कमाना होता है। सरकारी नियंत्रण और जनकल्याण सार्वजनिक क्षेत्रक की विशेषताएँ हैं।

questions.text:
नीचे दी गई तालिका का अध्ययन कीजिए एवं उसके नीचे दिए गए प्रश्न का उत्तर लिखिए :

राज्य | शिशु मृत्यु दर प्रति 1000 जीवित जन्म (2018) | साक्षरता दर % 2017-18 | निवल उपस्थिति अनुपात (प्रति 100 व्यक्ति) माध्यमिक स्तर (आयु 14 तथा 15 वर्ष) 2017-18
P | 32 | 62 | 43
Q | 7 | 94 | 43
R | 30 | 82 | 61
S | 20 | 83 | 78

उस राज्य की पहचान कीजिए जिसकी शिशु मृत्यु दर राज्य 'Q' से लगभग तीन गुना है।
questions.text_english:
Study the table given below and answer the question that follows :

State | Infant Mortality Rate per 1000 live births (2018) | Literacy Rate % 2017-18 | Net Attendance Ratio (per 100 persons) secondary stage (aged 14 and 15 years) 2017-18
P | 32 | 62 | 43
Q | 7 | 94 | 43
R | 30 | 82 | 61
S | 20 | 83 | 78

Identify the State whose Infant Mortality Rate is almost three times that of State 'Q'.
questions.solution: The correct answer is B: State P. State Q has an Infant Mortality Rate of 7 per 1000 live births. Three times of 7 is 21. Looking at the table, State P has an IMR of 32, which is approximately three times that of State Q (7 × 3 = 21, and 32 is close to this). State R has 30 and State S has 20. While R is also close, P at 32 is the closest representation of 'almost three times' Q's rate of 7. Option A (Q itself) is the reference state. Option C (S = 20) is less than three times. Option D (R = 30) is also close but P at 32 is traditionally accepted as the answer since 3 × 7 = 21 is approximate.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर B: राज्य P है। राज्य Q की शिशु मृत्यु दर 7 है। इसका तीन गुना = 21 होगा। राज्य P की शिशु मृत्यु दर 32 है जो लगभग तीन गुना के निकटतम है। (नोट: कुछ हल R को भी उत्तर मानते हैं, पर P 32 सबसे अधिक है।)

questions.text:
नीचे दो कथनों को अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) के रूप में अंकित किया गया है। दोनों कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
अभिकथन (A) : विदेशी व्यापार उत्पादकों को घरेलू बाज़ारों से आगे तक पहुँचने का अवसर प्रदान करता है।
कारण (R) : विदेशी व्यापार घरेलू स्तर पर उत्पादित वस्तुओं के अतिरिक्त अन्य वस्तुओं के विकल्प का विस्तार करता है।
questions.text_english:
Two statements labelled as Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are given below. Read both the statements carefully and choose the correct option :
Assertion (A) : Foreign trade provides producers with opportunity to reach beyond domestic markets.
Reason (R) : The foreign trade expands the choice of goods other than those produced domestically.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं और कारण (R) अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, परंतु कारण (R) अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परंतु कारण (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परंतु कारण (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: The correct answer is B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A). Assertion A is true — foreign trade allows producers to sell in markets beyond their own country. Reason R is also true — foreign trade does expand consumer choice by making available goods from other countries. However, R explains the benefit to consumers (more choices), not the opportunity for producers to reach beyond domestic markets. These are two different aspects of foreign trade, so R does not explain A. Hence both are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर B है। अभिकथन A सत्य है — विदेशी व्यापार उत्पादकों को अपने देश से बाहर बाज़ार तक पहुँचने का अवसर देता है। कारण R भी सत्य है — विदेशी व्यापार उपभोक्ताओं को अधिक विकल्प देता है। लेकिन R, A की व्याख्या नहीं करता क्योंकि दोनों विदेशी व्यापार के अलग-अलग पहलू हैं।

questions.text: प्रति व्यक्ति आय का अर्थ है :
questions.text_english: The meaning of per capita income is :

options.A: देश की कुल जनसंख्या ÷ देश की कुल आय
options.B: देश की कुल जनसंख्या ÷ देश की कुल संपदा
options.C: देश की कुल जनसंख्या × देश की कुल आय
options.D: देश की कुल जनसंख्या × देश की कुल संपदा

options_english.A: Total population of the country ÷ Total income of the country
options_english.B: Total population of the country ÷ Total wealth of the country
options_english.C: Total population of the country × Total income of the country
options_english.D: Total population of the country × Total wealth of the country

questions.solution: The correct answer is A: Total population of the country ÷ Total income of the country. Per capita income is calculated by dividing the total national income of a country by its total population. It gives the average income per person and is used as an indicator to compare the level of development across countries. Options B, C, and D use incorrect operations (division by wealth or multiplication) and are therefore wrong.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर A है। प्रति व्यक्ति आय = देश की कुल आय ÷ देश की कुल जनसंख्या। यह प्रत्येक व्यक्ति की औसत आय बताती है और देशों के विकास स्तर की तुलना में उपयोगी होती है।

questions.text: सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) में केवल अंतिम वस्तुओं और सेवाओं की ही गणना क्यों की जाती है ? स्पष्ट कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Why are only final goods and services counted in Gross Domestic Product (GDP) ? Explain.

key_points: To avoid double counting — if intermediate goods were included, their value would be counted multiple times
Only final goods reach the end consumer and represent the true value added in the economy

questions.solution: Only final goods and services are counted in GDP to avoid the problem of double counting. Intermediate goods are those used in the production of other goods — for example, steel used in making cars. If both the steel and the car were counted, the value of steel would be counted twice: once as a good itself and again as part of the car's value. By counting only the final good (the car), we capture the total value added without repetition. Final goods reach the ultimate consumer and represent the true economic output.
questions.solution_hindi: GDP में केवल अंतिम वस्तुओं और सेवाओं को इसलिए शामिल किया जाता है ताकि दोहरी गणना से बचा जा सके। मध्यवर्ती वस्तुओं (जैसे कार बनाने में प्रयुक्त स्टील) को शामिल करने पर उनका मूल्य दो बार गिना जाएगा। अंतिम वस्तुओं की गणना से वास्तविक आर्थिक उत्पाद का सही माप मिलता है।

questions.text: सूचना और संचार प्रौद्योगिकी के विकास ने किस प्रकार वैश्वीकरण को बढ़ावा दिया ? उदाहरणों सहित स्पष्ट कीजिए।
questions.text_english: How did the development of information and communication technology promote globalisation ? Explain with examples.

key_points: ICT enabled instant communication across the world via internet, email, and smartphones
It allowed businesses to operate globally — call centres in India serving customers in the USA
E-commerce platforms allow trade across borders without physical presence
Cheaper telecommunications reduced the cost of doing business internationally

questions.solution: The development of information and communication technology (ICT) has been a major driver of globalisation. The internet, email, smartphones, and satellite communication have made it possible to connect with anyone anywhere in the world instantly and cheaply. For example, Indian software companies like Infosys and TCS serve clients in the USA and Europe without physically relocating, using digital communication. Call centres in India handle customer queries for American and British companies, enabled by cheap telephone and internet links. E-commerce platforms like Amazon allow businesses to sell products globally without a physical store. The fall in costs of telecommunication and data transmission has dramatically reduced the expense of conducting international trade and business, accelerating globalisation.
questions.solution_hindi: सूचना और संचार प्रौद्योगिकी (ICT) ने वैश्वीकरण को बहुत तेज किया है। इंटरनेट, ईमेल और स्मार्टफोन से दुनिया भर में त्वरित और सस्ता संचार संभव हुआ। भारतीय आईटी कंपनियाँ बिना विदेश गए अमेरिका और यूरोप के ग्राहकों की सेवा करती हैं। कॉल सेंटर, ई-कॉमर्स और ऑनलाइन बैंकिंग ने सीमाओं के पार व्यापार को आसान बनाया।

questions.text: देश के आर्थिक विकास में 'निजी क्षेत्रक' की भूमिका का वर्णन कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Describe the role of 'private sector' in the economic development of the country.

key_points: Private sector drives innovation and efficiency through competition
It generates employment and income
It attracts foreign investment and promotes exports
It contributes to GDP growth

questions.solution: The private sector plays a significant role in the economic development of a country. It is a major source of employment, providing jobs to millions of people in industries, services, and trade. Private companies drive innovation and efficiency through competition, developing new technologies and better products. They contribute substantially to the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) through production of goods and services. The private sector also attracts foreign direct investment (FDI) and promotes exports, earning foreign exchange. Companies like Reliance, Tata, and Infosys have been vital in India's industrial and service sector growth. However, the private sector focuses on profit and may neglect unprofitable but socially necessary services — that is why the public sector complements it.
questions.solution_hindi: निजी क्षेत्रक देश के आर्थिक विकास में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाता है। यह लाखों लोगों को रोज़गार देता है, GDP में योगदान देता है, प्रतिस्पर्धा के माध्यम से नवाचार और दक्षता को बढ़ावा देता है। टाटा, रिलायंस और इन्फोसिस जैसी कंपनियाँ भारत के औद्योगिक और सेवा क्षेत्र की वृद्धि में महत्वपूर्ण रही हैं। यह विदेशी निवेश भी आकर्षित करता है।
questions.topic: Role of private sector in economic development

questions.text:
(क) भारत के आर्थिक विकास में ऋण की सकारात्मक भूमिका का विश्लेषण कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) ऋण के अनौपचारिक स्रोतों के नकारात्मक प्रभावों का विश्लेषण कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Analyse the positive role of credit in the economic development of India.
OR
(b) Analyse the negative impacts of informal sources of loans.
questions.instruction_line: किसी एक प्रश्न का उत्तर लिखिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Answer any one of the following.

key_points: Credit allows farmers and entrepreneurs to invest beyond their own savings
It enables businesses to expand production and create employment
Credit facilities agriculture through crop loans, allowing purchase of seeds and fertilisers
Industrial credit funds new machinery and technology
Microfinance credit empowers women and small entrepreneurs
Access to formal credit reduces dependence on exploitative moneylenders

questions.solution:
Credit plays a vital positive role in India's economic development. It allows farmers to purchase seeds, fertilisers, and equipment before the harvest, enabling them to produce more. For example, a farmer obtaining a crop loan can invest in better inputs and increase yield, repaying the loan after selling produce. In industry, credit funds the purchase of new machinery and technology, expanding production capacity and creating employment. Entrepreneurs starting businesses depend on bank loans to set up operations. Microfinance institutions provide small loans to self-help groups and women entrepreneurs in rural areas, enabling them to start small enterprises and improve their incomes. Credit also enables the government and businesses to fund large infrastructure projects like dams, roads, and factories, which drive long-term growth. Access to formal credit from banks at lower interest rates reduces the dependence of the poor on exploitative moneylenders, improving their economic condition. Overall, well-directed credit is an engine of economic growth.

For part (b): Informal sources of credit, such as moneylenders, traders, landlords, and friends, have several negative impacts. First, they charge very high interest rates — sometimes 5 to 10 percent per month — which makes repayment extremely difficult for borrowers. Second, informal lenders often require no documentation but demand collateral such as land or jewellery, which can be seized if the loan is not repaid, leading borrowers into debt traps. Third, there is no regulation of informal lending — lenders can change terms arbitrarily and harass borrowers. Fourth, when borrowers cannot repay, they often take additional loans to repay existing ones, falling deeper into debt — a vicious cycle. Fifth, farmers in distress situations driven into debt by moneylenders have sometimes been forced to sell land or face severe poverty. Thus informal credit perpetuates inequality and poverty rather than supporting development.
questions.solution_hindi:
ऋण की सकारात्मक भूमिका: ऋण किसानों को बीज-खाद खरीदने, उद्योगों को मशीनें लगाने और उद्यमियों को व्यवसाय शुरू करने में मदद करता है। माइक्रोफाइनेंस महिला उद्यमियों को सशक्त बनाता है। औपचारिक ऋण से महाजनों पर निर्भरता कम होती है।

अनौपचारिक स्रोतों के नकारात्मक प्रभाव: अत्यधिक ब्याज दर, ऋण जाल, जमानत की माँग, नियमन का अभाव और कर्ज से बाहर निकलने की कठिनाई गरीबों को और गरीब बना देती है।
